race.comment: Looks a nice race for the in form YOU NEVER CAN TELL (6) who won well first up here over 1200m before a game third out to this trip. Fitter again now and can roll forward, go close. TITAN OF CHOICE (1) doesn't boast the best winning strike rate but ran a strong race last time out, finishing third and beaten only 2.5 lengths over 1400m at this track. Did beat YOU NEVER CAN TELL prior and will be running on late. QUBELLA (10) found the line nicely to grab third last time out over 1400m at this track in the same race. Right in the mix again. IMMORTALISED (17) broke his maiden last start over 1600m at this track, scoring by 0.8 lengths. Can go on with it coming back in trip.
